title: Accelerated TMS hits SXSW Stage
subtitle: Tim Ferris shares his experience with this authors favorite modality
body_html:
South by Southwest is a great festival if you want to hear about disruption. Things are getting disrupted, left and right! It is hard to keep track of anything that hasn't been disrupted— if ones’ only point of reference is the SXSW main stage!

Subscribe now

Every once in a while, an actually disruptive thing sneaks its way into the conference. It's not all NFTs and psychedelics that are still illegal but will change everything, we promise!

This year, Tim Ferris brought conversation about accelerated trans cranial magnetic stimulation and the Nobel prize in waiting science of Nolan Williams’ Brain Simulation lab at Stanford to SXSW.

The video is here!

Thanks for reading. I promise, it's not just me talking about it.

This modality is available at Acacia Clinics and Fermata in NYC.

Share
